column1: Stripe payment modal missing scrollbar, hiding "Pay Subscribe" button at default zoom.
column26:
When a user attempts to purchase a premium package and clicks on the card option, the Stripe payment modal appears. This modal is missing a scrollbar, which causes the "Pay Subscribe" button to be hidden from view at default browser zoom levels (e.g., 100%). The user has to reduce the browser's zoom to 75% to make the button visible and complete the subscription. 

*Steps to reproduce:* 

1. Click to buy a premium package. 
2. Click on the premium button. 
3. Click on the card option to bring up Stripe payment fields. 
4. Observe that the "Pay Subscribe" button is not visible without zooming out in the browser., [https://i.ibb.co/qFcz53cf/Screenshot-2026-01-10-144451.png|https://i.ibb.co/qFcz53cf/Screenshot-2026-01-10-144451.png]

column1: Header "Update to Premium" button text becomes invisible on hover
column26:
When a user has not purchased any package, a "Update to Premium" button is visible in the header. Upon hovering over this button, both the button's background and its text turn white, making the text unreadable.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Log in as a user who has not purchased any package.
2. Locate the "Update to Premium" button in the header.
3. Hover the mouse cursor over the "Update to Premium" button.
4. Observe that the button's background and text both turn white, making the text unreadable., https://i.ibb.co/xK9f4YP7/Screenshot-2026-01-10-114932-1.png
